description: A factory provides rides for its employees in either taxis or company cars. Each taxi ride can take 2 employees while each company car ride can take 3 employees. Since buying and maintaining cars is expensive, at most 60% of the rides can be company car rides. However, there has to be at least 30 company car rides. If the company needs to transport at least 500 employees, how many rides of each should be done to minimize the total number of taxi rides.

EmployeesPerTaxiRide.definition: Number of employees that can be transported in one taxi ride.

EmployeesPerCompanyCarRide.definition: Number of employees that can be transported in one company car ride.

MaxCompanyCarRidePercentage.definition: The upper limit on the proportion of total rides that can be company car rides.

MinCompanyCarRides.definition: The minimum required number of company car rides.

MinEmployees.definition: The minimum number of employees that need to be transported.

objective.description: "Minimize the total number of taxi rides required to transport the employees."

constraints.code:
model.addConstr(
    EmployeesPerTaxiRide * TaxiRides
    + EmployeesPerCompanyCarRide * CompanyCarRides
    >= MinEmployees
)

CompanyCarRides.definition: Number of company car rides provided
